verdict.rationale: The only documented ingestion limit is a 25 MB per-file cap on the transcription API, which suggests a bounded upload rather than acceptance of multi-hour recordings in one job. No maximum duration is documented anywhere, and nothing in the pack shows multi-hour files being processed in a single job, either via the API or the open-source package.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-hour recordings are accepted in a single job, with the maximum duration and file size documented
